key_strengths: Fresh QIIME2 and R executions cover every central claimed engine.
The numeric helper makes no-plot depth choice reproducible.
Multiple metrics and dispersion are required before interpretation.

recommendations.title: Make GlobalPatterns depth choice use the helper
recommendations.problem: The shipped GlobalPatterns example selects a tenth-percentile depth although the main Skill now supplies a numeric plateau helper.
recommendations.fix: Invoke the helper on exported counts, or label the quantile choice explicitly as a toy-example placeholder rather than a production rule.
